value.rationale: The motivating framework proves mixed ESS convergence under reciprocal W and highlights the influence of symmetry on local stability as unresolved. This sharp two-community structural extension covers every positive contact asymmetry and positive constant migration pair, and identifies a physically admissible directed matrix with complex but decaying eigenmodes, separating oscillatory transients from instability. It resolves a natural model-theoretic first case rather than an arbitrary single numerical specialization.
